subject: Request: Release integrity artifacts for SDLC audit
messages:
From: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@veritas-audit.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: security-assessor@veritas-audit.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: artifacts for release on 2027-06-28

Hi Priya,

We're kicking off the SIG/SOC2 follow-up for the FinBank engagement and need to validate the secure release controls for your 2027-06-28 production deployment. Can you provide the following artifacts? A consolidated zip or Drive folder is fine.

- Code review evidence for the release (PRs, reviewers, timestamps, and any approver comments)
- CI pipeline run output for the release job (build logs, test results, artifact checksums)
- Change approval tickets and the KT (who approved + timestamp)
- Secrets management proof: rotation events, vault access audit (at least one rotation record in the 90 days prior to release)
- Release manifest listing commits/SHAs and container image digests

If some items are sensitive, a redacted export or an auditor read-only Drive link is acceptable. Targeting a quick review — can you get this to us by EOD Wednesday (2027-07-21)?

Thanks,
Morgan
Morgan Ellis
Senior Assessor, Veritas Audit
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@veritas-audit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: artifacts for release on 2027-06-28

Morgan — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide these. I've looped in Marissa (release lead) and Vivek (security eng) to assemble a consolidated package.

Proposed delivery plan (timeline):
- By EOD Tue (2027-07-20): code review export + release manifest + change ticket PDF
- By EOD Wed (2027-07-21): CI run artifacts + secrets rotation log (redacted where necessary)

If that works, we'll share a Drive folder with read-only access and a short indexing README. Please flag any additional proof you need (KMS/HSM audit logs, signing key timestamps) so we can include them.

Regards,
Priya Natarajan
Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful. Couple of follow-ups before we reconcile the evidence: 

1) For secrets rotation proof: can you include the rotation event that precedes the release (timestamp + who triggered it)? We typically need the vault event entry or a redacted rotation log.
2) For CI artifacts: please include the build job log that contains the image digest verification step and any artifact checksum verification (a truncated log is fine).
3) Do you have a control mapping (matrix) showing which internal SDLC controls map to SIG control IDs? If so, a spreadsheet would help expedite the auditor review.

If it's easier, you can upload everything to a read-only Drive folder and I'll pull from there.

—Morgan
